captions: This is PRISM, PHILRADS’s app for response,
inventory and our team.
Here’s how to use it in the field.

chapters.title: Install and sign in
chapters.context: Get PRISM ready on your phone

captions: Open the PRISM link in your phone browser.
Choose Add to Home Screen.
The first tap starts the theme.
Tap the speaker to mute it.
Staff, enter your email and password.
The eye reveals it.
Tap Sign in.
If it shakes, check your password.
Forgot your password? sends a reset email.
Volunteers, use your invited email.
Tap Email me a code.
Enter the six-digit code, then tap Sign in.
Guest lets visitors look around.
Set up quick unlock.
Staff lock or sign out after five idle
minutes, except during live sharing.

chapters.title: Welcome and Home
chapters.context: Find your work and get around

captions: The welcome greets you by name.
Tap Let’s go.
Home has View my tasks, Verse of the
Day, and a calendar with deadlines and holidays.

beats.cue: Needs your answer · Today · Coming up
captions: My tasks groups work by what needs your
answer, today and what’s coming up.
The top bar has Search, Active, the bell
and your account.
Tap the menu to move between modules.
Admin tools are at the bottom.

chapters.title: Notifications
chapters.context: Go straight to the right task

captions: Tap a new note to open the right
task. Phone notifications work when PRISM is closed.
Open the bell and switch between All and Unread.
In the account menu, switch notification or
error sounds. Choose Do not disturb for quiet.
Use Mine, Given or Team.
Lists follow the six PHILRADS programs.
In Today, open the request.
Tap Accept to take it, or Can’t take
it to decline.
Tap Start when you begin.
Check off the steps as you go.
Tap Finish or swipe right to finish.
Swipe left to plan the task for Today.
Add a note and links if needed.
This task needs a photo, so take one
at the distribution.
Tap Finish and send.
On tasks where a photo is optional, it
earns five extra XP.
The giver can edit, reassign, send back or
remove it. Read the note if it comes back.

shots.cue: Choose a person, due date, list and priority

captions: Tap New task to assign work.
Pick a person or the whole team, then
the due date, list and priority.
Finish a task each workday for twenty-five XP.
See your levels, program badges and team goal.

chapters.title: Live Map
chapters.context: Let the team know where you are

captions: Live Map shows warehouses, response sites, project
and activity places, and teammates.
Tap Share location, then Start sharing.
Share while you’re out so the team knows
where you are.
Tap Stop on the floating bubble when you’re
done. For one check-in, tap Check in here.
Tap a place to see its live stock
and the people served.
Use the map controls for weather, temperature,
Full screen or Show all places.
Search for an item.
Filter stock by category or location.
Open an item marked Low stock.
The quantities come from PHILRADS IMS.
Open Activity log for receipts, releases and transfers.
In Stock, tap Export and choose a spreadsheet
or a printable report.
Use Response to coordinate needs assessment,
distribution and reporting.
Start a new relief event.
Add the details and continue in IMS for approval.

shots.cue: Find the response on Live Map

captions: Once the event is approved in IMS, it
appears on Live Map.
In Documentation, tap Upload.
Pick photos, videos, PDFs or reports.

shots.cue: Link the file to a project or response

captions: Choose the right project or activity.
Upload while you’re there.
Don’t wait until you’re back at the office.
The file goes to its Google Drive folder.
PRISM keeps a record.
Use All, Media or Records to find what you need.
Open a form. Type into the fields laid
out like the paper original.
Use the text size controls to make your
entries bigger or smaller.
When the form asks for a signature, sign
on screen with your finger.
Tap Print or Save as PDF.
Use the paper size set for the form.

chapters.title: Projects, Resources & Statistics
chapters.context: Find project work, files and results

captions: Open a project for its schedule, team, tasks,
files and cost. Assign a task to several people.
Swipe the resource categories.
Tap Preview to open a file.
The three-dot menu lets you Open in Google,
Download or Copy link.

shots.cue: Find the activity on Live Map

captions: Statistics shows where and when PHILRADS worked,
and who was served, since twenty twenty-three.
See it on Live Map.
Funding and donors are restricted.
PDM is in the menu and marked Coming soon.
Tap your photo to change it.
Drag and zoom to frame it.
Add your position and a short bio.
Choose a frame and set your profile to
Public or Private.
Your account menu has themes, sound switches,
What’s new and Sign out.
Unlock quickly. Share your location.
Finish with a photo.
Upload on the spot.
Offline, work with what’s already loaded.
Updates install when safe.
If What’s new asks, tap Update now when ready.
One system, three jobs: response, inventory
and our team. PRISM by PHILRADS.
